fields.title: Junior Biomedical Engineer (Tender & Proforma Specialist)
fields.description: We are seeking a proactive Junior Biomedical Engineer to focus on Tender Management and Proforma Invoice Preparation . This role sits at the intersection of technical medical equipment knowledge and commercial business processes. The ideal candidate will review medical equipment specifications, compile winning tender bids, and issue accurate technical proforma invoices to clients. Key Responsibilities Tender Management: Track, analyze, and prepare comprehensive technical and financial bid documents for public and private healthcare tenders. Proforma Preparation: Draft and issue accurate Proforma Invoices based on client requirements and equipment specifications. Technical Evaluation: Review medical equipment specifications, datasheets, and user manuals to ensure compliance with tender requirements. Vendor & Client Liaison: Communicate with equipment manufacturers for pricing/specs and interact with clients to clarify bid technicalities. Market Research: Stay updated on medical device trends, pricing structures, and competitor offerings. Qualifications & Requirements Education: Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Biomedical Engineering or Medical Technology. Experience: 0–2 years of experience; prior exposure to commercial tenders or proforma preparation is a plus. Skills:- Strong knowledge of medical equipment and hospital supplies. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PDF tools). High accuracy in numerical data and document preparation. Attributes:- Excellent written communication, negotiation, and time management skills to meet strict submission deadlines.

raw_payload.description:
Job Description

Repair & Maintenance Engineer_ Electrical

Position Title: Repair and Maintenance Engineer

Reports to: Senior Repair & Maintenance Supervisor

About EcoMobby:

EcoMobby Spare Parts is a trailblazer in Ethiopia's automotive industry, proudly standing as the nation's first dedicated spare parts shop for electric mobility vehicles (EMVs). Established in March, 2024, we are committed to supporting the burgeoning EV ecosystem and ensuring a seamless ownership experience for our customers. It’s currently looking to expand its team with exceptional talent that will ensure premium service to its customers.

Purpose of the position

The Repair and Maintenance Engineer will diagnose, repair, and maintain electrical systems of e-bikes to ensure safety, reliability, and high-quality service. Support uptime, reduce repeat failures, and maintain accurate repair documentation.

1. Core Responsibilities

A. Electrical Diagnostics & Repair

  • Diagnose and repair charger faults such as unstable voltage, no output, overheating, and abnormal noise using appropriate electrical testing tools.

  • Test ECU and control systems for power supply, communication, and signal issues; replace faulty units and verify system functionality after installation.

  • Inspect wiring harnesses and connectors for damage, loose terminals, short circuits, or corrosion; perform continuity testing where required.

  • Repair or replace defective components including connectors, wiring sections, and basic PCB elements.

  • Interpret wiring diagrams and schematics to systematically troubleshoot faults.

  • Perform post-repair functional testing to ensure safe and reliable operation before bike release.

B. Preventive Maintenance

  • Conduct routine electrical inspections as per maintenance schedule.

  • Identify and report early signs of electrical failure to prevent breakdowns and downtime..

C. Root Cause & Quality Control

  • Conduct basic root cause analysis for recurring electrical faults and document findings.

  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the supervisor in a timely manner.

  • Verify that all repaired bikes meet safety and functional standards before release.

D. Documentation

  • Ensure all repair activities are properly documented in the job card system and master log.

  • Escalate recurring or repeated faults for further investigation.

E. Team & Workplace Support

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues efficiently.

  • Provide guidance to junior technicians as required.

  • Uphold 5S and workplace safety standards at all times.

2. Performance Expectations

  • Complete at least 95% of repairs within the agreed time.

  • Keep repeat repair cases below 5%.

  • Ensure all repair records are accurate and completed daily.

  • Follow all safety rules at all times.

Required Skills

  • Degree/Level IV in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field.

  • 2+ years of Experience in electrical diagnostics and repair (e-bike or similar systems is advantageous).

  • Ability to read wiring diagrams.

  • Skilled in using multimeter and electrical tools.

  • Basic soldering and PCB repair knowledge.

  • Strong problem-solving and attention to detail.

  • Workshop environment with exposure to tools, machinery, and occasional outdoor testing.

fields.title: Account Manager
fields.description: The Account Manager – Enterprise Segment is responsible for driving enterprise sales by developing and managing strategic relationships with government institutions, large corporations, financial institutions, and international organizations. The role focuses on promoting and selling enterprise IT solutions, including servers, storage solutions, networking equipment, workstations, and related technologies. The successful candidate will identify new business opportunities, manage key accounts, support tender activities, and collaborate with internal teams to deliver tailored enterprise solutions that maximize customer value and business growth. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute sales strategies to drive growth in the enterprise segment. Identify, pursue, and secure new business opportunities with government, corporate, financial, and international clients. Manage key enterprise accounts to ensure customer satisfaction, retention, and business growth. Build and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives, IT leaders, procurement teams, and other key stakeholders. Prepare and deliver sales presentations, proposals, quotations, and negotiate commercial agreements. Collaborate with the Tender Manager on identifying, preparing, and responding to enterprise tenders. Work closely with pre-sales and technical teams to deliver tailored enterprise IT solutions. Promote enterprise products, including servers, storage solutions, networking equipment, switches, and workstations. Develop and maintain strategic relationships with technology vendors and partners. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs to identify new opportunities. Achieve sales targets while maintaining accurate sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and CRM records. Represent the company at client meetings, industry events, and business development activities. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful solution delivery and maintain relevant product certifications. Qualifications Education Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Management, Marketing, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Experience 2–4 years of experience in enterprise sales, account management, or business development within the IT industry. Experience selling enterprise IT solutions, including servers, storage, networking equipment, and workstations. Experience working with enterprise, government, or private sector clients is highly preferred. Experience participating in tender processes is an advantage. Required Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of enterprise IT products and solutions. Proven ability to achieve sales targets and manage enterprise accounts. Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills. Strong business acumen with the ability to engage executive-level stakeholders. Experience preparing proposals, quotations, and tender documents. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM systems. Strong organizational, time management, and multitasking skills. Ability to work independently, collaborate across teams, and travel as required.

raw_payload.title: Assistance Accountant
raw_payload.description:
የቀጣሪ ድርጅት ስም ጌት ሃብ እንጨት  ፣ ብረትና አልሙኒየም ስራዎች ድርጅት

የስራ መደቡ ረዳት አካዉንታንት

የስራ ተግብርና ኃላፊነት

  •  የዕለት ተዕለት የወጪና ገቢ መረጃዎችን በሂሳብ መዝገብ ወይም በፋይናንስ ሶፍትዌር ላይ መዝግቦ መያዝ፣

  • ደረሰኞችን፣ የክፍያ ትዕዛዞችንና የባንክ ሰነዶችን ማዘጋጀትና ትክክለኛነታቸውን ማረጋገጥ፣

  •  የተሰበሰበን ጥሬ ገንዘብና ቼክ በወቅቱና በደህንነቱ በተጠበቀ ሁኔታ ወደ ድርጅቱ የባንክ ሒሳብ ገቢ ማድረግ፣

  •  ከሽያጭ ወይም ከሌሎች የገቢ ምንጮች የሚሰበሰቡ የጥሬ ገንዘብና የቼክ ክፍያዎችን በአግባቡ መቀበል፣

  •  ከንብረት ክፍልና ከግዥ ክፍል እንዲሁም ከሌሎች የፋይናን ክፍል ባለሙያዎችና ኃላፊዎች ጋር ተግባብቶና ተባብሮ መስራት፣

  •  የወርሃዊ፣ የሩብ ዓመትና የዓመታዊ የፋይናንስ ሪፖርቶችን ማዘጋጀት፣

  •  የሂሳብ ሰነዶችን በተገቢ መልኩ መያዝና ማዘጋጀት፣

  • ሁሉንም የሂሳብ ሰነዶች ለኦዲት በሚመች መልኩ ማዘጋጀት፣

  •  ከፍተኛ ሂሳብ ባለሙያዎች ጋር የሂሳብ ሥራዎችን በጋራ መስራት፣

  • ሌሎች ከስራው ጋር ተያያዥ የሆኑ ተግባራትን መፈጸም፣
    የስራ ልምድ

  •  የመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ በአካውንቲንግ ፣ በአካዉንቲንግና ፋይናንስ የትምህርት መስክ የተመረቀች አግባብነት ካለው የፈርኒቸር ተቋም ላይ ከ1(አንድ) ዓመት በላይ የስራ ልምድ ያላት፣

  •  የስራ ልምድ ማስረጃ ማቅረብ የምትችል።

 ሌሎች መስፈርቶች

  •  የፈርኒቸር ድርጅት የሂሳብ አሰራሮችን የምታዉቅ፣

  •  በቀላሉ የመግባባት ችሎታ ያለዉ፣

  • የፒች ትሪ ሶፍትዌር ችሎታ ያላት እና የስልጠና ሰርተፍኬት ያላት፣

  • የማይክሮሶፍት ወርድ ፣ ኤክሴልና በሌሎችን የኮፒዉተር እዉቀት ያላት፣

  •  ጥሩ ስነ ምግባር ያለዉ፣

  •  የድርጅቱን ሚስጥር ጠባቂ የሆነ

  •  የድርጅቱን ደንብና መመሪያ አክብራ መስራት የምትችል፣

  •  ከዚህ በፊት በፈርኒቸር ድርጅት ዉስጥ ከ1 ዓመት በአካዉንታንት ወይም በረዳት አካዉንታንት የስራ መደብ ላይ የሰራች ፣

  • ጎሮ ፣ መብራት ሃይል ፣ ሳሊተምህረትና ለጃክሮስ ቅርብ የሆነች አመልካች ብትሆን ይመረጣል፣

 

የሚያስፈልጉ ማስረጃዎች

  •  የትምህርት ማስረጃ ፎቶ ኮፒ

Supervise different departments, project teams, and operational activities. Establish clear goals, responsibilities, KPIs, and performance expectations for employees. Monitor company projects and ensure they are delivered according to agreed scope, timeline, and quality standards. Coordinate software development, product, business development, sales, marketing, finance, and administrative activities. Develop and improve internal operational procedures, policies, and reporting systems. Identify new business opportunities, partnerships, clients, and potential markets. Maintain strong relationships with customers, partners, government institutions, private organizations, and other stakeholders. Participate in negotiations, partnership discussions, proposals, and major business meetings. Monitor company performance, operational costs, revenues, project progress, and business objectives. Prepare management reports and provide regular updates to the CEO and leadership team. Identify operational risks and ensure appropriate corrective actions are implemented. Promote accountability, professionalism, innovation, collaboration, and a results-oriented working culture. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Economics, Information Technology, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field . Master's degree or MBA is an advantage. Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in management or leadership. Must have previous experience working as a General Manager, Operations Manager, Business Manager, Project Manager, Department Manager, or another comparable managerial role in an established company or organization. Experience working within a technology, software, startup, digital services, consulting, innovation, or related company is highly preferred. Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities. Ability to work directly with senior leadership and take ownership of business operations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. The ideal candidate should be: A strong and accountable leader. Highly organized and execution-focused. Comfortable working in a fast-growing technology environment. Commercially aware and capable of identifying business opportunities. Able to work independently with minimal supervision. What We Are Looking For We are not only looking for someone with a managerial title. We are looking for someone who has actually managed operations, teams, projects, and business responsibilities in another organization and can bring that practical management experience to Omishtu-Joy Tech Solutions. The successful candidate will play an important role in strengthening the company's operational structure, supporting its software products and projects, expanding strategic partnerships, improving execution, and helping Omishtu-Joy Tech Solutions scale sustainably.

fields.title: Social media & community manager
fields.description: RAMA Technologies PLC is producing a children’s educational animation series teaching young children in Amharic. Compensation Competitive salary based on experience, plus performance-based variable pay linked to agreed KPIs (channel growth, engagement, publishing consistency).

​ዝርዝር ኃላፊነቶች
​የመንገድ መመሪያን መከተል፡ የተመደበውን የማስታወቂያ ሳይክል በተወሰኑ መንገዶችና በተቀመጠው የጊዜ ሰሌዳ መሰረት ማሽከርከር።
​ሙያዊ ስነ-ምግባር፡ ሁልጊዜም ንጹህ እና ፕሮፌሽናል የሆነ ስነ-ምግባርን መላበስ።
​የንብረት እንክብካቤ፡ ብስክሌቱ እና የተገጠመለት ቢልቦርድ ሁልጊዜ ንጹህ እና ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ መሆናቸውን ማረጋገጥ።
​ሪፖርት ማድረግ፡ በስራ ሰዓት የሚያጋጥሙ ማንኛውንም ችግሮች፣ ብልሽቶች ወይም ክስተቶች ለሚመለከተው አካል ወዲያውኑ ማሳወቅ።
​የመሳሪያዎች አያያዝ፡ የዕለቱን ስራ እንደጨረሱ ብስክሌቱን እና ሌሎች መሳሪያዎችን በጥንቃቄ መመለስ።

raw_payload.title: Creative Content Growth Strategist (Video Marketing)
raw_payload.description:
About Tinova

Tinova helps founders build startups that customers trust, investors back, and markets adopt.

Alongside working with startup founders, we're building a founder-first personal brand that educates, inspires, and reaches entrepreneurs globally through high-quality content across LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, and Meta.

We're looking for a Creative Content Growth Strategist to become the strategic partner behind our founder's personal brand.

About The Role

This is more than a social media or video planning role. You'll combine content strategy, audience psychology, trend research, storytelling, and analytics to turn the founder's expertise into content people watch, share, and remember.

You'll work directly with the founder from idea to publication and continuously improve content based on performance data.

Responsibilities

  • Develop long-term content strategies, content pillars, and weekly/monthly calendars aligned with business goals.

  • Research startup trends, AI, fundraising, entrepreneurship, audience pain points, competitors, and creator strategies.

  • Identify trends and viral content opportunities and develop research-backed ideas.

  • Create stronger hooks, storytelling, CTAs, and content structures based on audience psychology.

  • Develop video concepts and shooting briefs; recommend pacing, editing, captions, B-roll, and visual storytelling.

  • Manage and optimize content across TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook (Meta), including publishing, scheduling, and engagement.

  • Track reach, watch time, retention, engagement, and conversions to identify what works and recommend improvements.

  • Collaborate with the founder, writers, designers, and editors to turn ideas into publish-ready content.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in content strategy, creator marketing, personal branding, or social media growth.

  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, LinkedIn, and Meta.

  • Strong research skills.

  • Excellent storytelling ability.

  • Understanding of content psychology and audience behavior.

  • Ability to recognize content trends early.

  • Strong communication skills.

  • Experience working with founders or personal brands is highly preferred.

 Success in This Role

Within your first 90 days, you'll:

  • Build a repeatable content strategy.

  • Create a high-performing content calendar.

  • Improve video retention and engagement.

  • Increase reach across TikTok and Meta.

  • Become the founder's strategic partner for content decisions.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone naturally curious, highly creative, and obsessed with understanding why content performs.

You should enjoy researching, spotting trends before they become mainstream, analyzing audience psychology, and continuously experimenting with new ideas.

If you watch a viral video and immediately start breaking down why it worked, you'll fit right in. 

How to Apply

Please send the following to tinovahr@tinovagency.com

  • Your Resume and LinkedIn profile

  • A short introduction about yourself (2–3 paragraphs)

  • Links to 3–5 personal brands or companies you've helped grow (include your role and contribution)

  • One piece of content (video, post, or campaign) you're most proud of, and explain why it performed well

  • A 60–90 second Loom video introducing yourself and telling us why you're the right fit for this role

Bonus (Highly Recommended)

Choose one of Tino's recent videos and share:

  • How you would improve the hook

  • What you'd change in the storytelling

  • How you'd edit it differently to improve retention

  • How you'd repurpose it for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and LinkedIn

We care more about how you think than how polished your answer is.

የስራው አይነት፡ ጉዳይ አስፈጻሚ

የስራ ልምድ፡ ቢያንስ 1 አመት ለዲፕሎማ ፣ ወይም 0 አመት ለዲግሪ

የትምህርት ደረጃ፡ ዲፕሎማ/ዲግሪ በቢዝነስ ማኔጅመንት ወይም በኢኮኖሚክስ እና ተያያዥ ዘርፍ  

 

ዋና ዋና ተግባራት

·         በተለያዩ የግልና የመንግስት መስሪያ ቤቶች ቀርቦ ጉዳይ ማስፈጸም

·         ደንበኞችን ተከታትሎ ክፍያ ማስፈጸም

·         የተለያዩ ክፍያዎችን ከሂሳብ ሰራተኛ ጋር በመቀናጀት ተከታትሎ ክፍያ መፈጸም

·         ባንኮች ላይ ያሉ ጉዳዮችን ተከታትሎ ማስፈጸም

·         የመኪኖች ቦሎና ኢንሹራንስ በወቅቱ ተከታትሎ መክፈል

·         በስራ ሃላፊ የሚሰጡ ተያያዥ ስራዎችን መፈጸም

·         ሳምንታዊ ሪፖርት በድርጅቱ ፎርማት መሰረት ማቅረብ

ተፈላጊ ችሎታ

·         የማይክሮሶፍት WORD እና EXCEL አፕሊኬሽን መጠቀም የሚችል

·         ከስራ ባልደረባ ጋር የመከባበር እና የመግባባት ችሎታ

·         በቡድን ውስጥ መስራት መቻል

·         ጥብቅ የስራ ትኩረትና የጊዜ አጠቃቀም ችሎታ

·         መንጃ ፍቃድ ያለው / ያላት ቢሆን ይመረጣል

አመልካቾች ከዚህ በታች የተዘረዘሩ ሰነዶችን ማቅረብ ይጠበቅባቸዋል
1. CV
2. የትምህርትማስረጃኮፒ
3. የስራልምድማስረጃኮፒ
4. መንጃፈቃድኮፒ
ለማመልከት ይህን ቴሌግራም ተጠቀሙ :@HR_ENGM

raw_payload.title: Junior Cameraman / Videographer
raw_payload.description:
Junior Cameraman / Videographer

Company: Benod Consulting Architects & Engineers
Channels: Benod Interiors & Benod Furniture
Location: Ayertena, Addis Ababa — On-Site / Field Work

About the Role

Benod Consulting Architects & Engineers is looking for an efficient and creative Junior Cameraman / Videographer to support the content production of our Benod Interiors and Benod Furniture channels.

We are looking for someone with a good visual eye who understands how to capture interesting and useful footage, rather than simply operating a camera. You will work closely with our video editor and creative team to film content at our office, furniture workshop, interior projects, construction sites, and other locations.

The role can be structured as either part-time or permanent, depending on the candidate and our production needs, with a monthly payment arrangement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Film social media and marketing content for Benod Interiors and Benod Furniture.

  • Accompany the team to interior project sites, construction sites, furniture workshops, and other locations to capture content.

  • Film behind-the-scenes footage, project progress, furniture production, installations, and completed projects.

  • Assist with filming planned content and studio-style productions.

  • Work closely with the video editor to ensure footage is properly captured and suitable for editing.

  • Understand basic framing, composition, lighting, camera movement, and shot selection.

  • Capture both planned shots and spontaneous moments that can be turned into engaging content.

  • Help organize and transfer footage for the editing workflow.

  • Suggest creative shots, angles, and ideas when filming.

  • Be flexible and ready to work in different environments, including offices, workshops, construction sites, and outdoor locations.

Required Skills

  • Previous experience in videography, filmmaking, content creation, or a similar role.

  • A good eye for composition, framing, lighting, and interesting visual details.

  • Basic understanding of cameras and video equipment.

  • Ability to capture stable, well-composed footage.

  • Understanding of what makes content engaging for social media.

  • Ability to work efficiently with a video editor and follow a content production workflow.

  • Good communication and teamwork skills.

  • Willingness to travel with the team to different project and workshop locations.

Equipment

Having your own decent camera or smartphone capable of producing good-quality video is an advantage.

For larger or more professional studio productions, additional cameras and equipment may be rented when required. Therefore, applicants do not necessarily need to own a complete professional camera setup.

Work Arrangement

  • Permanent or Part-Time

  • Monthly Payment

  • Primarily on-site and field-based

  • Work will take place at our office in Ayertena, as well as project sites, workshops, and other filming locations.

Location Preference

Our office is located around Ayertena, Addis Ababa. We strongly prefer candidates who live in Ayertena or nearby areas and can easily commute to the office and accompany the team to filming locations.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who is efficient, creative, observant, reliable, and comfortable working on the move. You don’t have to be an expert cinematographer, but you should have a strong visual sense, understand how to capture good footage, and be willing to learn and improve with our team.

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Updated CV

  • Portfolio or examples of previous video work

  • Links to social media content or videos you have filmed, if available

  • Information about the camera/equipment you currently have access to

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.

raw_payload.title: ረዳት ግዥ ሰራተኛ
raw_payload.description:
የረዳት ግዥ ሰራተኛ ስራ ኃላፊነት፤

  • የግዥ ሂደትንና አሰራርን በመተግበር መስራት የምትችል፣

  • አቅራቢዎች የመምረጥና ግዥ በወቅቱ ተግዝቶ እንዲቀርብ ከዋና ግዥ ባለሙያ ጋር በመሆን መስራት የምትችል፣

  • የግዥ ሂደቶችን ሙሉ በሙሉ በመጠበቅና ህጎችን በማክበር ግዥ መፈጸምና በማገዝ መስራት የምትችል፣

  •  የግዥ ዋጋዎችንና የክፍያ ሁኔታዎችን ከአቅራቢዎች ዋጋዎችን በመውሰድና ግዥ የሚፈጸመዉን ማንኛዉንም ንብረት ጥራትና ዋጋ በማወዳደር ግዥ እንዲገዛ ሲጸድቅ ግዥ የመፈጸምና ለሚመለከተዉ የንብረት ክፍል አንድ በአንድ ቆጥሮ በማስረከብ መስራትና በዚህም የስራ ልምድ ያላት፣

  •  የግዥ ሰነዶችን አደራጅቶ መዝግብ ላይ መዝጎ የመያዝ እና ግዥ የተፈጸመባቸዉን ሰነዶች ለሚመለከተዉ ፋይናንስ ክፍልና ንብረት ክፍል በወቅቱ እንዲወራረድ አድርጎ የመስራት(የስራ ልምድ ያለዉ)፣

  •  የግዥ ስራዉን በእቅድ መስራት የምትችል፣

  • ከንብረት ፣ ከፋይናንስና ከሌሎች የስራ ክፍሎች ጋራ በመናበብና በመተባበር መስራት የምትችል፣

  • የግዥ መመሪያና ደንቦችን አዉቃ መስራት የምትችል፣

  •  የግዥ ቀደም ተከተል በመከተል እና በማስፈጸም እለት በእለት ክትትል በማድረግ መስራት የምትችል፣

  •  ግዥ የተጠየቁ ማንኛዉም ቁሳቁስ በተፈለገዉ ቀንና ሰዓት ተገዝቶ እንዲገባ ከሚመለከተዉ ክፍል ጋር በመናበብ በማስፈጸም መስራት የምትችል፣

  •  ፈጣን የሆነች እና በቀላሉ ከአቅራቢዎችና ከባለሙያዎች ጋር መግባባት የምትችል፣

  •  የግዥ ክፍል ስራዎች በእለት ፣ በሳምንትና በወር የተሰሩ ስራዎችንና የስራ ሂደቶችን በማጠቃለል ሪፖርት ሰርታ ማቅረብ የምትችል፣

የስራ ልምድ  ፤

  •  በፈርኒቸር ስራዎች ድርጅት ዉስጥ በግዥ ወይም በረዳት ግዥ ከ1 ዓመት በላይ የሰራች፣

መሟላት ያለባቸዉ መስፈርቶች፤

  •  ፈጣን እና በቀላሉ መግባባት የምትችል(የመግባባት ችሎታ ያላት)፣

  •  የግዥ አፈጻጸሞችን እና ሂደቶችን የምታዉቅ፣

  •  ከንብረት ክፍልና ከፋይናንስ ክፍል ጋር ምን ምን የስራ ግንኙነት እዳላቸዉ ጠንቅቃ የምታዉቅ፣

  •  የስራ ልምድ ማቅረብ የምትችል፣

  •  በመጀመሪያ ዲግሪ in Supply Management, Logistics & Supply Chain Management, Business Administration,Accounting Or related field

  • ጥሩ የመረጃ አያያዝ ችሎታ ያላት፣

  • የኮፒዉተር ችሎታ ያላት(MS Office, Excel & ERP) etc.

  •  የመኖሪያ ቦታቸዉ ለጃክሮስ ቅርብ የሆች ቢሆን ይመረጣል፣

  •  የሚሰጠዉን ፈተና ካለፈች በኋላ ዋስ/ተያዥ ማቅረብ የምትችል፣

  • ደመወዝ፦ በስምምነት

  •  ብዛት፦ ሁለት(2)

  •  ጾታ ፦ ሴት

  •  የስራ ሰዓት፦ ከሰኞ እስከ ቅዳሜ ከ2፡00 እስከ 11፡00 ሰዓት

  •  የቅጥር ሁኔታ፦ ከ60 ቀን በኋላ በቋሚነት

fields.title: Office Engineer
fields.description: Job Details: Office Engineer ​ Position Title: Office Engineer (Civil / Construction Management)​ Department: Engineering ​ Reports To: Contract Admin / Operations manager ​ Location: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia (Head Office with periodic site visits) ​ Position Summary ​The Office Engineer serves as the critical technical bridge between site operations, design teams, management, and clients/consultants. Responsible for handling technical documentation, cost estimations, contract administration, quantity take-offs, variation orders, and tracking project schedules to ensure projects remain on budget and within contractual timelines.​ Main Roles & Responsibilities ​ 1. Technical Documentation & Design Review ​ Drawing & Specification Review: Analyze structural, architectural, and MEP drawings to verify completeness, identify discrepancies, and prepare Requests for Information (RFIs).​ As-Built & Shop Drawings: Oversee the review and approval of shop drawings and compile final as-built drawings upon project completion.​ Document Control: Maintain a centralized repository for all technical documents, submittals, material approvals, RFIs, and engineering correspondence. ​ 2. Estimating, Quantities & Payment Certificates ​ Take-Offs & BOQ: Perform detailed quantity take-offs based on engineering drawings to update Bills of Quantities (BOQ) and cost estimates.​ IPC Preparation: Prepare, review, and verify Monthly Interim Payment Certificates (IPCs) for main contractors, subcontractors, and consultants.​ Variations & Claims: Prepare justification files, unit price analyses, and documentation for variation orders, scope additions, and extension-of-time (EOT) requests.​ 3. Schedule Tracking & Bureau / Regulatory Approvals ​ Schedule Monitoring: Work alongside project managers to create, update, and track baseline project schedules and progress curves.​ Permits & Clearances: Assist in preparing technical submission packages for local municipal offices, sub-city construction bureaus, and utility providers for building permits and compliance approvals.​ Procurement Support: Prepare technical specifications and bid comparison sheets for materials, subcontracts, and specialized engineering items.

fields.title: Senior Outbound Growth & Marketing Specialist

As we continue to scale, we're looking for a Senior Outbound Growth & Marketing Specialist to own and optimize our outbound acquisition engine. About The Role This is not a traditional SDR role. We're looking for someone who understands startups, founder psychology, and modern outbound. You'll be responsible for identifying high-potential founders, researching companies, building personalized outreach campaigns, managing outbound across LinkedIn and Email, and continuously improving campaign performance through testing and optimization. You'll work directly with leadership to build a repeatable outbound system that generates meaningful founder conversations, and booked meetings. Analyze positioning, GTM strategy, funding stage, traction, and growth opportunities. Develop personalized outreach angles based on research. Create personalized cold emails and multi-step sequences. Maintain email deliverability and sender reputation. Track and optimize outreach performance. Campaign Management & Growth Build and manage outbound campaigns from scratch. Segment prospects by industry, funding stage, geography, and company maturity. A/B test messaging, CTAs, subject lines, and strategies. Develop new founder acquisition playbooks. Identify startup ecosystems, accelerators, and VC portfolios for prospecting. Recommend tools, workflows, and automation opportunities. CRM & Reporting Maintain accurate CRM records and track pipeline progression. Generate weekly campaign performance reports. Document learnings and successful messaging frameworks. Required Skills 3+ years of experience in B2B outbound marketing, growth, lead generation, or founder outreach. Exceptional research skills. Excellent written English. Strong understanding of startups, SaaS, fundraising, GTM, and founder ecosystems. Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Experience running personalized LinkedIn and email outreach. Strong copywriting skills. Ability to work independently and take ownership. What Success Looks Like Within your first 90 days, you'll: Build a scalable outbound system. Launch personalized LinkedIn and email campaigns. Consistently generate qualified founder conversations. Improve outreach response rates through experimentation. Become the owner of Tinova's outbound growth engine. Email to tinovahr@tinovagency.com We look forward to receiving your response.

fields.description: Job Description Job Title : Operations Assistant Job Type: Full-time Job Overview This document includes the job description as well as the tasks and responsibilities of the Operations Assistant position for gheero. In this position, it will be your sole responsibility to assist the operations of the company on a daily basis and to perform a variety of administrative and clerical tasks at gheero. Specific tasks and responsibilities for the position are provided hereunder. Tasks and Responsibilities Serve as the first point of contact for visitors, clients, and vendors, ensuring a positive experience, assisting with directions, office amenities, and maintaining a clean, organized reception and office area. Handle communications and correspondence, including calls, emails, packages, and calendar management, while supporting staff and management with scheduling and administrative tasks. Maintain office supplies, fixed assets, and inventory; support procurement, budget tracking, and invoice/payment processing with the finance team. Coordinate office upkeep, repairs, maintenance, security, and general facilities management to ensure a safe and functional work environment. Assist in organizing and supporting internal events, meetings, and office functions, contributing to smooth operations and team collaboration. Work closely with the Operations team to assist in the management of daily operations and communications with the team. Work on product management and system improvement initiatives. Attending to any correspondence and emails, providing necessary information, and liaising with relevant personnel/ departments for improved performance and work efficiency Attend all operational meetings, hold meeting minutes, and follow up and ensure the delivery of the action points from each meeting Engage in document preparation, review, and quality control through ensuring comment integration and fact-checking Ensure that all and every documentation, research, and other relevant outputs are up to the company and industry standards. Ensure agreed-upon weekly, quarterly, and annual plans are properly documented and track the performance of the team based on the plans and predetermined KPIs Assist with the preparation of management reports and monitor the submission and quality of the project and department reports Assist with operations coordination, including but not limited to preparation of schedules, managing calendars, tracking project milestones, coordinating meetings, arranging travel, event coordination, and office purchases. Assist in enforcing company policies and procedures within the company and keep track of implementation to identify problems and offer improvements. Analyze, understand strengths and gaps, and forward suggestions for improvement. Keep updated on industry trends. As needed, carry out supplemental administrative responsibilities and other crucial operational tasks that fall under the purview of the job title Requirement Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or related field. 0–2 years of experience in operations, administrative support, or office management. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize tasks. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace. Experience in scheduling, calendar management, coordinating meetings, and event planning. Knowledge of operational policies and procedures is a plus. Professional, proactive, and able to work independently or as part of a team. Discretion in handling confidential information and adapting in a fast-paced environment. Interested applicants, please send your CV and documents to recruitment@gheero.et Please use ‘Operations Assistant’ for the subject of your application email. Applications that do not use the required subject line will be disqualified and will not be considered. Good Luck!

fields.description: Job Summary The Procurement Officer is responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing the procurement of medical supplies, pharmaceuticals, equipment, office supplies, services, and other organizational requirements. The position ensures that goods and services are procured at the right quality, quantity, price, and time while maintaining transparency, proper documentation, and compliance with organizational policies and procedures. Verify that delivered items meet the required specifications, quantity, and quality. Maintain confidentiality and demonstrate integrity and transparency in all procurement activities. Perform other procurement-related duties assigned by the immediate supervisor. The step up from this job is Client Lead -- you'd run a client on your own and be the person they talk to. It pays significantly more, and we fill it by promoting someone who's already doing this job well. That's where this role is meant to lead.

What you'll do

  • Take a vague complaint -- "the schedule is wrong sometimes" -- and work out what's actually happening before changing anything.

  • Write down what a new feature should do, and just as importantly what it should not do, before any code is written.

  • Use the AI to build it, then check its work properly. Read the code like someone is trying to slip something past you.

  • Test on real data with the feature switched off, then switch it on and watch. Nothing goes straight to texting a hundred people.

  • When something breaks: stop the damage, find everything affected, then fix the cause -- not just the one thing that got reported.

  • Write short, clear updates. Most days that's how your team knows what's going on.

Who does well here

  • You've built something real. One thing is enough. Something messy, that other people ended up depending on. We'd rather hear about that than a list of technologies.

  • You don't take "it works" for an answer. A passing test and a green dashboard don't settle it for you. You go and check.
